snapshot.text: Public system rebuilding after Ebola, with a large share of care paid out of pocket. European partners launched two major programmes in support of the health system, and a national cancer plan runs 2026–2030.

priorities.title: National cancer plan 2026–2030
priorities.text: Guinea adopted a national strategic plan against cancer for 2026–2030.

priorities.title: Epidemic preparedness with France
priorities.text: France and Guinea agreed to work together against epidemics.
